name: Stealing Knowledge
summary: Jediga in Valormok asks you to recover four tablets from the Ruins of Eldarath. Each bears the name of a Highborne wizard, and she counts them among the valuable items lying around.

sections.title: Jediga's Request
sections.body: In Azshara, Jediga of Valormok has been making use of her situation after Belgrom's punishment. She says she did research before leaving and learned that valuable items remain in the area. Now she asks you to bring her four tablets from the Ruins of Eldarath, each named for a Highborne wizard.

faq.answer: Jediga in Valormok wants the four tablets.
The tablets are throughout the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
She asks for the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai.

faq.q: What are the tablets named after?
faq.answer: Each tablet is named after a Highborne wizard.
Her research turned up valuable items lying around Azshara, and the tablets are among them. She promises you will talk more once you bring them.
Jediga says Belgrom's punishment left her in a situation she has made the most of.
